Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints centered on neck pain and
stiffness consistent with cervical strain. The mechanism and force of the impact appear well matched to the injury described.
Over the course of sixteen visits, care included manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program.
Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency and intensity reducing steadily as symptoms resolved and mobility
returned. On examination, reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness support the reported injury, while
neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or
surrounding soft tissues is known to this provider. Separately, the billing records show two similar charges entered on the same
day, which are currently under review for accuracy. Based on current findings, the patient is expected to reach full recovery with
continued home exercise and periodic reassessment as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
